title: Apply opum-doc's ODOC-73 promotion guardrails to this repo's CI
description: opum-agent wave-2 addendum: apply the promotion guardrails from opum-doc's docs/runbooks/promote-dev-to-main.md Guardrails (ODOC-73) section to this repo's own CI, adapted to lore-cli's dev-gated shape (dev carries the one ruleset here, main carries none, so the ancestor check on push to main is the guard that matters most). Adds two jobs to .github/workflows/ci.yml: promotion-is-manual (fails on purpose on any PR targeting main) and main-is-fast-forward-of-dev (fails if main's new HEAD is not an ancestor of dev). Neither wired into required status checks, per opum-doc's own verified reasoning (a pull_request-scoped check never runs on a direct push, so requiring it would lock out the one correct promotion path).

acceptanceCriteria.text: ci.yml gains promotion-is-manual (fails on purpose, scoped to pull_request targeting main) and main-is-fast-forward-of-dev (fails on push to main whose new HEAD is not an ancestor of origin/dev)
Neither job is added to any branch ruleset required_status_checks
CLAUDE.md repo profile updated to describe the new automated guard alongside the still-required manual ancestor check
actionlint and a YAML parse both pass on ci.yml
